title: Camera Snapshot Delivery Latency Spike
dataSources: Object detections (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm state changes (`alarm:event`), smart-lock access (`lock:access`), plate and gate events (`gate:event`), and doorbell delivery telemetry (`doorbell:event`).
app: Home-security telemetry from Frigate and Blue Iris detections, camera health feeds, smart locks, alarm panels, doorbells, and gate sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and Home Assistant integrations.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=doorbell:event event="snapshot"
| stats perc95(delivery_latency_ms) as p95_latency_ms avg(delivery_latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms by camera
| sort - p95_latency_ms
description: Tracks delayed snapshot delivery from cameras and doorbells so network or storage slowdowns stand out before footage is missed.
value: Security footage loses value when alerts arrive late, and latency spikes often reveal Wi-Fi or NVR bottlenecks early.
implementation: Record alert creation and snapshot delivery times from your doorbell or camera integration and compare cameras weekly.
visualization: Bar chart of p95 snapshot-delivery latency by camera.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when camera pictures are starting to arrive too slowly, which can mean your alerts are getting less useful.
